task: Add independent showTask/showOutputSchema visibility options to the shared CommonStateFields component so Task and Output Schema only render for node types that actually consume them.

key_reasoning.reason: The change touches the shared CommonStateFields component plus four call sites (ToolTab, SubWorkflowTab, CustomTab, AssistantTab) and likely requires lifting custom_node_id state out of CustomNodeForm into CustomTab so Task visibility reacts to in-progress edits. CommonStateFields is a core shared utility, which raises the base component count/layer score from M to L.

Ten explicit ACs give a clear visibility matrix and preserve-hidden-value requirement, but the ticket itself flags one unresolved mapping ('Bedrock flow' has no corresponding CustomNodeType today) that must be confirmed during implementation, and the live vs. saved custom_node_id wiring is an open design decision not spelled out in the ACs.

TransformTab's existing showAllFields={false} override is an exact precedent for the core mechanism, and hidden-but-defaulted react-hook-form values already satisfy the preserve-stored-value requirement without new plumbing — low base risk. Bumped one step because AC10 requires a full visibility-matrix regression suite and CommonStateFields.test.tsx currently has zero coverage of its primary rendering logic, so that defensive test pattern must be built from scratch.

Estimated ~5-6 modified files (CommonStateFields.tsx, ToolTab.tsx, SubWorkflowTab.tsx, CustomTab.tsx, AssistantTab.tsx, possibly CustomNodeForm.tsx) plus 1-2 new files (a custom-node Task-visibility rule and new/expanded tests) across configPanels/ and configPanels/__tests__/.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from M to L: CommonStateFields is a core shared utility consumed by ToolTab, SubWorkflowTab, CustomTab, and AssistantTab.
Technical Risk bumped from S to M: AC10 enumerates a visibility-matrix regression suite with no existing render/visibility test template for CommonStateFields to extend.
